author: Warhammer
description:
Fatemasters are charismatic firebrands who weave plots and illusions to ensure their enemies’ annihilation. If you’re interested in giving your very own mastermind of the Arcanite Cults a formidable paint job, tune in to this video to see Ollie show you how!

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Base:
Abaddon Black
Corax White
Grey Seer
Leadbelcher
Runelord Brass
Steel Legion Drab

Shade:
Agrax Earthshade
Druchii Violet
Nuln Oil
Reikland Fleshshade

Layer:
Cadian Fleshtone
Dawnstone
Doombull Brown
Kislev Flesh
Screaming Skull
Stormhost Silver

Contrast:
Aethermatic Blue
Akhelian Green
Blood Angels Red
Skeleton Horde

Technical:
Lahmian Medium
Armageddon Dust

Brushes:
S Layer
M Layer
S Dry
S Base

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
